name: Evolution Fortress
description:
How to play:
-watch the cinematic (story).
-after, click the 'PLAY' button.
- click 1 or 2 to change weapon:
- 1 for axe, it can make resources.
- 2 for sword, it can simply kill zombies.
-Your character receive no damage, but if the 'energy core' is destroyed, you lose.
-Click your mouse to use your weapons.
-To gain resources, click the rock or the tree with your axe.
-Touch the 'SHOP' button to see the list of constructible turrets.
-You have to get enough ressource to build turrets.
-You have to survive 50 wave of zombie invasion to win.
-Every turret except the extractor and the wall have weapons to kill zombies.
-When you buy a turret, click R button to rotate it.
-----------------------------------------------------------------
Good luck!
